title: De Jong sends clear message to Flick over Barcelona starting place: ‘Don’t want to get used to being a substitute’
tweet: De Jong said he won’t settle for a substitute role and wants to return to the starting XI. As things stand, Flick may need to accelerate his reintegration, but the final decision hinges on medical assessments.

title: Neymar chooses PSG spell over Barcelona as his prime years: ‘People remember my time with MSN but…’
tweet: Neymar says his individual peak came in Paris, where he felt stronger, faster and more intelligent – a view he confirmed in a recent interview. However, the Barcelona era still defined his global rise; the stage was there, but his personal best feels to him elsewhere.

title: Three talking points ahead of FC Barcelona vs Real Madrid | La Liga MD 10
tweet: Flick’s line‑up for the Clasico will show whether El Clasico was truly the priority over the midweek PSG game. Real’s counter‑attack threat has risen; a single defensive lapse could change the outcome. A victory would stretch Barça’s lead to nine points early in the season, a cushion that could dictate the title race.
